title: a map literal with keys of different types is an error
purpose: The operation must fail instead of producing a value.

failure.justification: The contract makes the operation an error but leaves the detection stage open: a static pass may reject it when operand categories are known, otherwise it fails at runtime. It must never yield a value.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the owner decision D-047
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-047): map keys have exactly one type; any is not a map key, so 1 and "1" cannot be keys of one map.
